title: Inter-VLAN Routing Failure - Router-on-a-Stick Subinterface Mismatch
symptom: PC-A in VLAN 10 can ping its gateway 192.168.10.1, but cannot ping PC-B (192.168.20.10) in VLAN 20. Switch trunk link to Router R1 is active.
topology_notes: Switch SW1 Gi0/1 connects to Router R1 Gi0/0/0 (802.1Q trunk). PC-A is on SW1 Fa0/1 (VLAN 10, IP 192.168.10.10/24, GW 192.168.10.1). PC-B is on SW1 Fa0/2 (VLAN 20, IP 192.168.20.10/24, GW 192.168.20.1).
show_outputs:
R1# show ip interface brief
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status                Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/0/0   unassigned      YES manual up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/0/0.10 192.168.10.1    YES manual up                    up
GigabitEthernet0/0/0.20 192.168.20.1    YES manual up                    up

R1# show running-config interface g0/0/0.20
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0.20
 encapsulation dot1Q 25
 ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0

SW1# show interfaces trunk
Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan
Gi0/1       on           802.1q         trunking      1

Port        Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1       1-4094
expected_fault: Encapsulation VLAN tag mismatch on subinterface G0/0/0.20 (configured for VLAN 25 instead of VLAN 20).
ground_truth_fix:
R1(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0.20
R1(config-subif)# encapsulation dot1Q 20
R1(config-subif)# ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0
R1(config-subif)# end
R1# write memory
verification_command:
PC-A> ping 192.168.20.10
R1# show running-config interface g0/0/0.20
